_comment: Gap backlog for the autonomous /loop gap-fill run. Populated 2026-07-09 from the GPT-5.6-terra shipped-skills audit (memory-bank/status-updates/shipped-skills-gap-audit-2026-07-09.html). Each tick, tools/gap_driver.py pulls the highest-priority pending item, works it in its own worktree via the routed GPT-5.6 tier, has Sol review, and folds it in. Status: pending -> in_progress -> review -> merged | review_failed | blocked.

items.title: Port the five deferred emulator fishing methods
items.detail: karambwanji net, rainbow fish, lava eel (oily rod), Lumbridge swamp slimy-eel/frog-spawn dual-output, cave eel. See DEFERRED_FISHING_CONTENT in fishing_data.py:282-317. Source rows already in game-main Fish.kt / FishingTool.kt / FishingSpot.kt.

items.title: Complete the pottery/urn catalogue
items.detail: crafting_data.py:90-99 has only selected Mining/Cooking urn rows; PotteryData.kt also has Fishing, Woodcutting, Smelting, Prayer, normal, decorated tiers.

items.title: Complete leather/dragonhide tables + tanning service
items.detail: Only a few bodies/gloves/boots exist; chaps, vambraces, coifs, lower-tier leather absent despite LeatherData.kt. Tanning family from TanningData.kt not imported at all.

items.title: Fill jewellery tiers, earth/fire battlestaves, basket/net weaving
items.detail: Partial jewellery matrix (emerald->onyx bracelets/amulets); BattlestaffData.kt has all four elementals but only water/air present; WeavingData.kt has basket + unfinished net rows we lack.

items.title: Add concentrated coal and concentrated gold rocks
